content: next/font/google downloads Google Fonts files at build time and self-hosts them from the apps own domain with no runtime request to Google CDN, computing a fallback-font size-adjust to prevent layout shift. next/font/local is for fonts not on Google Fonts such as Departure Mono, pointing at local woff2 files. Declare once in the highest common layout; for a single-page app that is app/layout.tsx.
